name: Spring River Oaks
description: About 130 sites on the Spring River near Hardy: primitive tent plus 30/50-amp RV with water and electric, and a dump station — no sewer at the sites. Also kitchen cabins in 2BR and 3BR layouts plus sleeper/camper cabins; cabin count not fully published. Reservations by phone.

name: Star Falls Cabins
description: Two two-story cabins sleeping 4-6 each, at Cherokee Village near where the South Fork meets the Spring River. Books through Airbnb and direct.

name: Spring River Cabins and Campground
description: Five cabins on 50 acres of the Spring River with hiking trails on site — the Big cabin sleeps 8, Cypress 4-5, 40 Steps 5, Knotty Pine 5-6, and the River Cabin 12+ — plus 16 power-and-water campsites and room for primitive camping. All cabins have A/C, heat, wifi and Roku. Books through VRBO, Airbnb, Hipcamp and by phone.

name: Riverside Resort
description: Five- and eight-mile float trips on the Spring River with rafts, tubes, kayaks or canoes and shuttle, at Mammoth Spring. About 50 RV sites (30/50-amp water and electric), 200+ tent sites and a dump station, plus 16 cabins — 6 large and 10 camper cabins. Books through FareHarbor.

name: Camp Miramichee Falls
description: Eight rental cabins two miles from downtown Hardy on the South Fork, a mile above its confluence with the Spring River. The River Cabin sleeps 4 and the Lakehouse Lilypad 9, with others sleeping 2-6. Books through Airbnb, VRBO and Hipcamp.

name: Hardy's Spring River Lodge
description: A 49-room motel at Hardy on the Spring River, with a pool and continental breakfast. No cabins. Reservations direct or by phone.
